svg.title: Count visible pairs before discussing a sparse speedup
svg.desc: Rows are queries i; columns are source keys j. N = 8, self-inclusive causal window W = 4.
svg.text: Count visible pairs before discussing a sparse speedup
Rows are queries i; columns are source keys j. N = 8, self-inclusive causal window W = 4.
Blue = permitted; orange = extra global pairs; pale = masked. No future pairs are added.
At query 7, uniform local retrieval gives 6.5; adding value 1 at global key 0 gives 5.4.
